messages:
marta: Quick sync — marketplace push tomorrow morning. Top items: demo rack allocation for hardware partners; partner preview links and asset formats; embargo timing vs partner handoff; CTA variant finalization. Who's on what?

devon: Im on demo logistics. EdgeWorks requested 2x 2U + network VLAN tagged for demo tenant. Confirmed rack slot C11. I'll DM logistics the rack sketch and ship ETA.

lee: Partner preview: generated secure preview links for vendors (edgeworks, acmecorp, nova). Links expire T+90m. Included both 2:1 and 16:9 hero screenshots in PNG+SVG. Also added small/large image variants for mobile.

marta: Nice. Press timing? press-bot, confirm embargo plan and when partners get assets.

press-bot: Embargo: lift at 08:15 PT. Partners receive secure kit at T-25m (private link). Press distribution at T via wire and targeted list. Reminder: partners must not republish before T. Kit URL will contain UTM template param and explicit cache-bust guidance.

lee: UTM template added to tracking doc: utm_source=marketplace, utm_partner={{partner_slug}}, utm_campaign=q2_marketplace_launch. Analytics will also tag partner-referral cookie for attribution.

devon: Ops question: will demo use staging SKU? We should avoid affecting provisioning.

marta: Demo tenant demo-2026 pinned. Staging SKU only, no production provisioning touched. Ops please ensure isolation.

ops-bot: Rollout window reserved 08:15-08:40 PT. Health gates: listing request success >=98.5% and median page load <800ms for 5m rolling window. Auto-fallback: switch to "static-tiles" bundle if errors exceed threshold. Note: provisioning records are not auto-rolled back. Manual DB revert required for provisioning state changes. CDN invalidation at T+90s.

lee: Small technical ask for partners: include two logo formats (PNG 2x + SVG) and a short alt-text. Also include pricing tile in cents for parity.

devon: Hardware vendor logistics: added power strip and 10Gb uplink to rack C11 per EdgeWorks request. Shipping arrives T-1d. Contact: rachel@logistics.

marta: CTA variant vote: A) "Try in Marketplace" (partner parity) B) "Launch Demo" (higher conversion). Call it now.

lee: A for parity. Partners expect consistent wording across listings.

devon: B for demo conversion, but can live with A if legal needs it.

marta: Leaning A to avoid confusion. We'll ship A unless legal flags a problem.

press-bot: Note: press quotes locked. Partners may add short co-branding notes in partner kit but not in press release. No quote edits after embargo lift.

marta: Final go/no-go at 07:00 PT. Please post single-word: yes/no/blocker. If blocker, 1-line and tag me.

lee: yes

devon: yes

marta: Thanks  opening partner handoff channel at T-30m. If any connector smoke fails, partners to paste logs here and escalate to #support.
